steps.title: Read the risk
steps.prompt: Read all 7 of these fields of this KYC case (every one is needed): "Risk rating · Decided", "Risk · Suggested rating", "Risk · Screening hits", "Risk · PEP", "Risk · Residence", "Risk · Occupation and funds" and "Risk · Income vs volumes".

steps.title: Why the bank says yes, or not
steps.prompt: You are the second pair of eyes: read the risk lines above, then write in one or two sentences why the bank accepts this risk, needs a proof of the source of funds first, or refuses.

steps.title: Onboard this customer?
steps.prompt: Your decision, as the senior officer.

steps.title: Approve KYC - Medium or High
steps.prompt: Run "Approve KYC - Medium or High": the senior approves the risk the operator rated; your note says why the bank accepts it. It refuses when a document, an ID or a screening hit is still open.

steps.title: Ask for a proof of funds
steps.prompt: Run "Request missing documents": with every paper on file, it asks where the money comes from (notary deed, sale contract, payslips). The case waits on the client; the result card shows the request.

steps.title: Reject KYC
steps.prompt: Run "Reject KYC": the reason is pre-filled from the failed checks.
